title: Create constrained palette ramps for high-density UIs and compact chart surfaces
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: Compact tables and small-multiple charts in dense dashboards are visually noisy with the current token palette. High-chroma accents lose legibility at small sizes, and subtle elevation/shadow combos introduce perceptual banding when rows are tightly stacked. We need a constrained, low-variance palette ramp plus companion micro-geometry (spacing/radius) and shadow presets that are safe for compact surfaces and accessible at typical dashboard scales.

Goal: Deliver a small, deterministic set of color ramp tokens and compact UI geometry tokens (spacing, radii, micro-shadow presets) that: 1) reduce chroma variance for chart fills and table rows, 2) provide clear contrast anchors for text and small icons at 12–14px, 3) preserve data distinguishability in charts while avoiding visual noise, and 4) include a migration plan for components using the existing palette and elevation tokens.
acceptance_criteria: Define a constrained color ramp (neutral + 4 accent steps) with token names and hex/RGB values suitable for compact UIs
Provide companion semantic tokens for text-on-accent at two contrast targets (AA at 14px, and AAA where feasible) and document contrast metrics
Ship spacing and radius tokens for compact rows (row-gap, cell-padding, compact-button-radius) with examples in tables and small-multiple charts
Publish three micro-shadow presets (flat, lifted, divider) designed to avoid banding on stacked surfaces and documented with visual regression images
Create migration notes and a codemod plan for replacing existing palette usages in Tables, Charts, and Button components
Design review approved and accessibility review completed with remediation checklist
Implement visual regression tests (Percy or Chromatic) for representative dense views and add to CI gating
decisions: Adopt 4-step accent ramp instead of 6 to limit chromatic variance on small surfaces
Prefer desaturated accent base with contrast anchors rather than pure hue variants to preserve legibility
Introduce 'compact-' prefix for geometry tokens to make migration explicit (e.g. compact-row-gap, compact-radius-sm)
tasks: Audit existing components for small-size palette usage (Tables, MiniCharts, Sparklines, Chip buttons)
Propose token names and export master tokens file for engineering
Produce visual examples (Figma) of migrated Tables and Charts at 320–1280px widths
Coordinate with frontend eng on PR for token exports and scss/css variables
Write migration guide and codemod patterns for token replacement
Run accessibility contrast checks and iterate on text-on-accent pairings
